items.title: OpenAI fires three safety researchers, who dispute the reason
items.summary: OpenAI fired three safety researchers for mishandling research information, per TechCrunch. The researchers dispute that characterization and warn the firings will chill future internal safety reporting. (2 minute read)

items.title: StepFun's Step 5 Preview, a 1M-context MoE, lands on OpenRouter
items.summary: StepFun's Step 5 Preview is a mixture-of-experts model with a 1M-token context window, now live on OpenRouter. It's a hands-on release rather than just an announcement, so anyone can query the full context window directly. (2 minute read)

items.title: Bilibili ships Index-Translate, an open 150-language model family
items.summary: Bilibili released Index-Translate, a Qwen3.5-based translation family covering 150 languages, with 2B, 9B, and 35B-A3B checkpoints on Hugging Face and ModelScope. Companion models add voice-preserving speech translation and long-document context, plus GGUF/FP8/FP4 quantized builds and a free API for the 35B-A3B model. (2 minute read)

items.title: Typesafe AI raises $870M at $7.5B
items.summary: Typesafe AI closed an $870M round at a $7.5B valuation. (1 minute read)

items.title: Iranian campaign planted ChatGPT-written articles in US outlets
items.summary: An Iranian influence campaign used ChatGPT to draft articles that ran in real U.S. publications, according to the Washington Post. (1 minute read)

items.title: Microsoft ships MXC, a sandboxed runtime for untrusted model code
items.summary: MXC is Microsoft's sandboxed execution system for running untrusted model output and tool calls, with SDKs in Rust, .NET, and Node. It picks a platform-native backend per OS — Bubblewrap on Linux, Seatbelt on macOS, ProcessContainer on Windows — and enforces JSON-configured filesystem, network, and UI policies. (2 minute read)

items.title: A mathematician's critique of OpenAI's Partition Principle claim
items.summary: A mathematician lays out specific objections to how OpenAI handled a math result involving the Partition Principle. (1 minute read)

items.title: AI search through 400 years of archives turns up a lost meteorite
items.summary: Running AI over 400 years of archival records turned up a previously unrecorded meteorite and a population of 'lost' rhinos. (1 minute read)
